name: crates.io proxy
description: Caching proxy for the crates.io registry.
about: Caches the crates.io sparse index and crate downloads. Requires an x86-64 host. Configure source replacement in each Cargo client, using sparse+<proxy URL>/index/ as the registry index. The proxy serves plain HTTP without authentication.

variables.label: Cache folder
variables.description: Stores cached index entries and crate files. The folder must be writable by UID 777.

variables.label: Host port
variables.description: The port cargo clients connect to.

variables.label: Proxy URL
variables.description: Base URL reachable by Cargo clients, including the host port. Used to generate crate download links.

variables.label: Index cache lifetime (seconds)
variables.description: How long a cached index entry is served before the proxy fetches it again.
